# openai_tenant_workload_identity_provider (Data Source)

Beta. Retrieve a tenant workload identity provider. Requires tenant.workload_identity.read.

Authentication: Set the tenant_admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_TENANT_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the tenant API audience; with a custom tenant_base_url, set the tenant_admin_api_key provider attribute explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_tenant_workload_identity_provider" "example" {
  workload_identity_provider_id = "workload_identity_provider_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workload_identity_provider_id` (String) Workload identity provider ID.

### Read-Only

- `attribute_conditions` (String) attribute conditions
- `attribute_transformations` (Attributes List) Attribute expressions evaluated against the incoming identity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_transformations))
- `audience` (String) Expected audience claim. Supply a compatible OIDC audience for API organization rules.
- `can_manage_provider` (Boolean) can manage provider
- `check_jti` (Boolean) check jti
- `created_at` (Number) created at
- `custom_ca_certificate` (String) Public CA certificate for a supported remote verification method.
- `description` (String) description
- `enabled` (Boolean) enabled
- `id` (String) id
- `issuer` (String) issuer
- `max_assertion_lifetime_seconds` (Number) max assertion lifetime seconds
- `name` (String) name
- `owner_id` (String) owner id
- `owner_type` (String) owner type
- `type` (String) Credential type. The API defaults to oidc.
- `updated_at` (Number) updated at
- `verification` (Attributes) Verification method and its settings. Set type to discovery for standard OIDC discovery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification))
